newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian motorbike maker KTM H1 pretax up 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Austrian motorbike maker KTM H1 pretax up 12 pct.

text.p: Austria's sole motorcycle maker KTM on Monday posted a 12 percent rise in pre-tax profit to 57 million schillings for the first half of the year to 31 August.
Group sales climbed 23 percent to 615 million schillings compared to 502 million in the year ago period.
In the first half 9,280 motorbikes were sold, against 8,017 last year.
The company said the second half had got off to a good start due to high orders and delivery. In March alone over 2,000 bikes were sold bringing in a turnover of 134 million schillings.
